title: Signature Management
summary: This module defines and manages the structure of DSPy signatures, handling field definitions, type conversions, and metadata for language model interactions.

nodes.label: SignatureMeta
nodes.title: Signature Metadata Class
nodes.description: Metaclass for DSPy Signatures, responsible for dynamically creating signature classes, validating fields, and managing instructions and field properties.

nodes.label: OldInputField
nodes.title: Legacy Input Field
nodes.description: Represents a legacy input field within a DSPy Signature, used for compatibility with older field definitions.

nodes.label: OldOutputField
nodes.title: Legacy Output Field
nodes.description: Represents a legacy output field within a DSPy Signature, used for compatibility with older field definitions.

nodes.label: Convert New to Old Field
nodes.title: Field Conversion Utility
nodes.description: A utility function that converts a new-style field definition into its corresponding legacy OldInputField or OldOutputField representation.

groups.label: Signature Definition
groups.title: Signature Definition and Management
groups.description: Handles the core logic for defining and managing DSPy Signatures, including field validation and instruction handling.

groups.label: Field Conversion
groups.title: Field Type Conversion
groups.description: Manages the conversion between different versions of field definitions within DSPy Signatures.
